messages.subject: Project Falcon - SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

First draft of the share purchase agreement attached for your review. Key commercial terms reflect the heads: EV £52m, estimated equity value £44.6m, £2m escrow. We've proposed a warranty cap of 25% of consideration, de minimis £25k, basket £250k, and a 24-month general warranty period. Look forward to your mark-up.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
